portal_description:
The sbd packages provide integration with hardware-based watchdogs allowing the SBD utility to be used as a cluster-fencing device. SBD watches the cluster process and initiates a hardware reset if one of the processes fails or the node loses quorum.

This update fixes the following bug:

* Previously, the sbd daemon triggered a reboot when it detected a timeout or any unexpected behavior. If the hardware watchdog that was supervising the sbd daemon was configured to trigger a poweroff, a race between the poweroff and the reboot occurred. In this situation, an unexpected reboot may happen instead of a poweroff. If the hardware watchdog was not available, it was not possible to configure poweroff as a recovery mechanism. With this update, the configuration settings have been fixed to enable the consistent configuration of poweroff as a recovery mechanism. (BZ#1666201)

Users of sbd are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix this bug.
